content: वाक्यम् [वच्-ण्यत् चस्य कः] .²1 Speech, words, a sentence, saying, what is spoken; शृणु मे वाक्यम् ‘hear my words’, ‘hear me’; वाक्ये न संतिष्टते ‘does not obey’; संक्षिप्तस्याप्यतोऽस्यैव वाक्यस्यार्थगरीयसः <ls>Śi. 2. 24</ls>. .²2 A sentence, period (complete utterance of a thought); वाक्यं स्याद्योग्यताकाङ्क्षासत्तियुक्तः पदोच्चयः <ls>S. D. 6</ls>; पदसमूहो वाक्यम् <ls>Tarka K.</ls>; श्रौत्यार्थी च भवेद्वाक्ये समासे तद्धिते तथा <ls>K. P. 10</ls>. .²3 An argument or syllogism (in logic). .²4 A precept, rule, an aphorism. .²5 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) The solar process for all astronomical computations. .²6 An assertion, statement. .²7 Command. .²8 (In law) Declaration, legal evidence. .²9 Betrothment.
